crossRefs.note: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”
Yahweh said to Joshua, “Get up! Why have you fallen on your face like that?
Arise; for the matter belongs to you, and we are with you. Be courageous, and do it.”
Then Ezra arose, and made the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they would do according…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Why do you cry to me? Speak to the children of Israel, that they go forward.
translations.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Why are you crying out to Me? Tell the Israelites to go forward.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward.
